title: Grusch's secondhand spaceship testimony explained as misidentified test drone

tellings.quote: just take the case of Grush saying I talked to somebody who interacted with this spaceship. He told me it was a spaceship.

related.note: Shermer takes Grusch's congressional testimony, that a witness told him about a spaceship, and explains it as a misidentified test drone. That is a different core claim about the same testimony.

plain: Michael Shermer, a writer often called America's top skeptic, talks about David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who testified to Congress in 2023. Shermer points out that Grusch's spaceship claim was secondhand: Grusch said someone who had dealt with the object told him it was a spaceship. Shermer's view is that such an object could have been a test drone that was misidentified, which would mean the story says less than it seems.
